messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High router tail latency detected: routing.router.p99 = 14.7s over 10m window (SLO 2s). streaming RPC error rate ↑ 2.3x. auto-page -> #incidents. alert_id=rbw-rt-1812364321

Mara (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping in. Tagging eng-sre & runtime. Any initial customer impact? :phone:

Jamie (eng-sre): Yep p95 ~1.6s but p99 ~ 12-20s intermittently. Streaming stalls reported; a few clients hit read timeouts. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/r/rt/route-tails?from=now-20m

Ana (support): Support queue: streamly-inc reported 4 dropped streaming sessions in last 7m, two with partial payloads. Ticket #2248 escalated to P1. Kara (acct) notified.

Kara (acct): Affected customer is enterprise tier. Keeping AE in loop. Please flag if SLA credit likely.

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Checking router control logs. We had a routing rollout at 09:12 to "v3-affinity" that changes hashing and affinity thresholds. I'm seeing abnormal key concentration on shard-eu-11 and frequent cross-zone handoffs to us-west causing long RTTs. Sample log:
```
2026-03-15T09:16:05Z router[rt-3]: policy=v3-affinity eval key=vid-xyz -> shard=eu-11 weight=0.84
2026-03-15T09:16:07Z router[rt-3]: handoff_attempt -> target=eu-11 busy fallback=us-west-03 lat=168ms
2026-03-15T09:16:22Z router[rt-3]: stream_stall seq=211 backend_latency=15300ms
```

Jamie (eng-sre): eu-11 queue depth spiking to 1100, CPU ~98%. Hot partition confirmed. Mis-hashing + affinity sticky windows look like the trigger.

Mara (oncall): Can we throttle the affinity or revert? What's lowest-risk quick fix?

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Options: 1) rollback policy to v2-stable via controlplane (fast), 2) temporarily disable strong affinity (toggle flag), 3) bump eu capacity (infra). I can toggle affinity flag in ~30s. Rollback is also quick but discards other changes.

Jamie (eng-sre): I recommend doing affinity toggle first to reduce instantaneous reshuffle. That avoids global config churn. Also start shard drain for eu-11 and open autoscale.

Mara (oncall): Do it. Dmitri, flip the flag. Jamie open drain and infra ticket. Ana prep customer message.

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Flipping flag: `routectl set-flag affinity_strict=false --policy v3-affinity` now.

deploy-bot: config_change: affinity_strict=false applied by dmitri_runtime at 1812364400

Jamie (eng-sre): Kicking off: `routectl drain-shard eu-11 --grace 45s` and filed infra request infra-8812 to scale eu pool +3 GPUs.

incident-bot: action_event: drain_started shard=eu-11 by jamie_sre at 1812364430

Mara (oncall): Monitoring. Any delta in p99?

Jamie (eng-sre): p99 decreased from 14.7s -> 5.4s in ~90s. Good trend but not back to SLO yet. Queue depth on eu-11 down to 220.

Ana (support): Draft to streamly-inc: "We observed intermittent streaming stalls and are applying routing mitigations; we're draining an overloaded shard and scaling capacity. Expect improved stability within 10-20 minutes. Please share any recent request IDs if you see issues."

Kara (acct): Sent to AE and CC'd streamly-inc. They replied: "Thanks, sending logs now."

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Diving deeper: the new affinity normalization multiplies weights by bucket cardinality incorrectly when cardinality > 100k. Patch ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/PR/472 (fix adjusts normalization).

Jamie (eng-sre): Infra-bot reports autoscale job started.

Infra-bot: pool_scale_request accepted: eu +3 GPUs job=infra-8812 at 1812364605

Mara (oncall): If affinity toggle is keeping p99 trending down, any reason not to roll back the rollout?

Dmitri (eng-runtime): I'd prefer to keep the toggle and apply a hotfix for normalization. Rollback would help but introduces rollback impact for other unrelated improvements. Hotfix iteration should be quicker and lower-risk. I'll push PR and request emergency deploy to canary first.

Jamie (eng-sre): Agree with hotfix+canary. Also add a temporary gating rule: abort rollouts that increase per-shard qdepth > 2x in 5m.

Priya (product): Noted. We'll add rollout gating to the postmortem actions. Please ensure AEs get RCA.

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Opening emergency PR and requesting deploy to canary: `git push && hub pr create --title "fix: affinity normalization for high-cardinality"` PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/PR/473

deploy-bot: deploy_request: PR/473 -> canary by dmitri_runtime at 1812364800

incident-bot: infra_event: autoscale eu +3 GPUs completed at 1812364950

Jamie (eng-sre): Autoscale completed, eu pool capacity +3. eu-11 queue reduced to <50, CPU ~45%. p99 now 1.8s. Looks back within SLO.

Ana (support): streamly-inc acknowledges restoration: "Stream resumed, thanks." Closing P1 ticket scheduled after postmortem.

Mara (oncall): Great. Next steps: Dmitri to merge hotfix and create deployment guard. Jamie to update runbooks with new gate and drain play. Ana/Kara to wrap customer timeline. Priya to drive postmortem meeting.

Dmitri (eng-runtime): Will merge PR and add a canary metric for per-key bucket skew. Also enabling a breaker to abort future v3 rollouts until approval.

Jamie (eng-sre): Running p99 sweep: `p99_sweep --window 30m --threshold 2s` -> p99 = 1.7s, p95 = 1.1s. No further tail anomalies across regions.

incident-bot: incident_status -> mitigated at 1812366000 (p99 restored < 2s). Monitoring for stabilization window.

Priya (product): Scheduling postmortem in 24h, owner list: Dmitri (root cause/fix), Jamie (mitigation & runbook), Ana (customer comms), Kara (billing/SLA assessment).

Mara (oncall): Closing livepage. Please file final notes & link to PRs/graphs in the postmortem doc. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: deploy_complete: PR/473 rolled to canary at 1812366400

Ana (support): Sent final update to streamly-inc: "Mitigation applied and service restored; engineering will follow up with a root cause and timeline."

incident-bot: incident_closed -> resolved at 1812366520. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled, sev review in 48h.
